acceptance: pi_rpc_client.rs defines `pub struct PiRpcClient` (state behind one std::sync::Mutex<Inner> so event methods take &self) with: `pub fn spawn(program: &Path, extra_args: &[String], cwd: &Path, resume_session_id: Option<&str>, handshake_timeout: Duration) -> Result<PiRpcClient, String>`; `pub fn session_id(&self) -> String`; `pub fn begin_prompt(&self, blocks: &[ContentBlock]) -> Result<u64, String>`; `pub fn cancel(&self) -> Result<(), String>`; `pub fn prompt_in_flight(&self) -> bool`; `pub fn poll_event(&self) -> Option<AcpClientEvent>`; `pub fn wait_event(&self, timeout: Duration) -> Option<AcpClientEvent>`; `pub fn shutdown(&self) -> Option<String>`; `pub fn host_exited(&self) -> bool`

spawn args are exactly ["--mode","rpc","-na"] then, if resume_session_id is Some(id), ["--session", id], then extra_args; it calls PiRpcProcess::spawn, then handshake(&mut process, handshake_timeout), then PiRpcSession::new; every failure is an Err(String) with context

begin_prompt: Text blocks' text joined with "\n\n" is the message; ResourceLink blocks contribute their uri as a line; every other block kind contributes a short line like `[image omitted]` (put a `// ponytail:` comment naming the gap: images are not forwarded yet); an empty result is an Err; it calls the session's begin_prompt, increments a u64 counter starting at 1, remembers it as the active request id, and returns it

poll_event and wait_event return ONE AcpClientEvent per call using an internal VecDeque for the remainder of a PiStep::Events batch. Mapping: Events(evs) -> push all, return front; RunFinished{aborted} -> AcpClientEvent::RequestFinished{ id: <active request id>, method: "session/prompt", result: Ok(serde_json::json!({"stopReason": if aborted {"cancelled"} else {"end_turn"}})) } and clear the active id; PromptRejected(e) -> RequestFinished{ ..., result: Err(e) } and clear the active id; Error(t) -> AcpClientEvent::Error(t); Exited -> AcpClientEvent::Exited exactly once and mark host exited; Idle -> None. poll_event uses Duration::ZERO. Queued events are returned before reading a new step

cancel calls the session's abort (Err when no run is active). prompt_in_flight is session.run_active(). shutdown takes the session out of its Option and drops it, returning Some(session_id) the first time and None after. host_exited is true once Exited was observed or the session was shut down

mod.rs gains only `mod pi_rpc_client;` next to the existing pi_rpc_* lines; one explanatory #![allow(dead_code)] at the top of pi_rpc_client.rs like pi_rpc_session.rs (nothing calls it yet); NO other file is modified; the file stays under 400 lines
No tests in this packet (the next packet adds them). `cargo clippy` must pass and `cargo nextest run -p ajax-web pi_rpc` must still be 31/31
